newsitem.title: THAILAND: Two Thai drug suspects killed in highway shootout.
newsitem.headline: Two Thai drug suspects killed in highway shootout.

text.p: Two suspected drug traffickers were killed and three police wounded on Thursday following a shootout on a provincial Thai highway, police said.
They said the shootout on the highway in Banmee district of Lopburi province, about 150 km (90 miles) north of Bangkok, took place after an hour-long car chase.
Undercover police had been trying to buy amphetamines, but the alleged drug traffickers realised their potential customers were police and escaped, police said.
The shootout followed when police caught up with the suspects on the highway.
Police seized 20,000 amphetamine tablets from the suspects.
Earlier this week a suspected trafficker was killed and a policeman was wounded following a similar shootout in Prathum Thani province on Bangkok's outskirts.
